description: This Rust source file implements a secure deletion data manager for Cuttlefish, providing functionality for managing secure deletion secrets, including creation, retrieval, deletion, and persistence to disk. It defines the HostSddManager struct and its associated methods, as well as trait implementations for secret management.

classes.name: HostSddManager
classes.description: Manages secure deletion data, including loading from disk, creating new secrets, retrieving, deleting, and clearing all secrets.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the manager by loading existing data from disk or creating new secure deletion data.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Creates a new instance of HostSddManager, initializing it with secure deletion data.

methods.name: get_or_create_factory_reset_secret
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the factory reset secret.

methods.name: get_factory_reset_secret
methods.description: Returns the factory reset secret if available.

methods.name: new_secret
methods.description: Generates a new secure deletion secret, assigns a slot ID, and saves it.

methods.name: get_secret
methods.description: Retrieves the secure deletion secret for a given slot.

methods.name: delete_secret
methods.description: Deletes the secret associated with a given slot.

methods.name: delete_all
methods.description: Deletes all secrets and removes the data file.
